mentions.name: Book Explorer
mentions.description: A non-fiction book companion, like Sparknotes, that pushes book content into a non-fiction ontology so books can be summarized, easily skimmed, and deep-dived by particular areas; one of the author's most frequently used tools.
mentions.problem: The author doesn't have time to read many non-fiction books in full but still wants to skim them and explore particular areas in depth.
mentions.source_excerpt: Project: Book Explorer - like Sparknotes for non-fiction. Pushes everything into an ontology for non-fiction so that it can summarize it and make it very easy for me to "skim" books that I otherwise don't have time to read. Also helps me to deep dive into particular areas. This is probably one of my most frequently used tools.
